BiblicalUsage: Our sons are prayed to be as plants grown up in their youth, strong and straight and rooted.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a son grown like a plant is the picture of God's blessing on a household: planted young, watered well, and standing straight when the storms come.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
